# Decompiled Method Ledger

Track class and method roles here as they are confirmed. Avoid dumping full decompiled source; keep this as a concise
map from obfuscated symbols to meaning.

| Symbol                                | Status    | Working Name                        | Notes                                                                                                                                                                      |
|---------------------------------------|-----------|-------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `FinalFantasy`                        | Confirmed | MIDlet entry point                  | Manifest uses `FinalFantasy` as the MIDlet class.                                                                                                                          |
| `b`                                   | Partial   | Shared data/menu loader             | Owns static data-loading routines and some menu/event flow. Shop/menu code uses `aZ`/`ba` indexes elsewhere after event openers load shop type/row data.                   |
| `b.C()`                               | Confirmed | Shared data loader                  | Loads `cp` chunks into spell metadata, weapon/armor records, shop inventory tables, growth data, prices, and other shared data arrays.                                     |
| `f`                                   | Partial   | Canvas, input, audio, resource core | Extends `Canvas`; owns key mapping, paint loop, resource reads, RMS helpers, vibration, and Java ME MIDI `Player` lifecycle.                                               |
| `f.b(int)`                            | Confirmed | Prepare/select BGM                  | Selects resource `"a" + (trackId & 0x1ff)`, creates an `audio/midi` `Player`, and avoids reloading when the requested track id is already current.                         |
| `f.b(int,int)`                        | Confirmed | Queue BGM playback                  | Queues BGM track playback with a repeat/restart counter. Stock BGM ids use `0x8000` high-bit ids such as `32768..32789`.                                                   |
| `f.f(int)`                            | Confirmed | Queue BGM stop                      | Queues a stop for the matching current track id; consumed by the audio loop and implemented through `f.n(int)`.                                                            |
| `g`                                   | Confirmed | Battle runtime                      | Owns battle command order, spell/effect resolution, physical damage, running, rewards, and level-up/spell-charge growth.                                                   |
| `g.F()`                               | Confirmed | Battle reward and level-up routine  | Applies EXP/level-up flow and spell-charge growth. Strong level-up, universal charges, and 15 max charge patches target this area.                                         |
| `g.G()`                               | Confirmed | Battle turn queue builder           | Builds the actor/action queue. The party action-order patch targets this method.                                                                                           |
| `g.a(byte,int,int)`                   | Confirmed | Spell/effect resolver               | Resolves spell/effect records for battle casts and item/equipment invocations. Uses `j.a[spellId][4]` as effect kind. INT damage/healing and hero magic-resistance patches target this helper. |
| `g.f(int)`                            | Confirmed | Battle spell target preset          | Initializes selected target for router values `2` and `4`: single opposing-side spells start on the first valid opposing target, and self spells target the caster.          |
| `j.a[spellId][1]`                     | Confirmed | Spell/effect target router          | Loaded from `cp0` chunk 1 source byte `3`. Editor labels: `1` Omni/Enemy, `2` Single target/Enemy, `4` Self/Self, `8` Omni/Party, `16` Single target/Party.                   |
| `j.a[spellId][7]`                     | Confirmed | Spell/effect animation flags        | Loaded from `cp0` chunk 1 source byte `9`. Battle animation routing checks bit `0x02` to draw omni spell visuals once per affected target instead of the fallback position.    |
| `g.a(boolean,boolean,int,int)`        | Confirmed | Physical damage helper              | Resolves hit, defense, critical, weapon affinity/family effectiveness, and damage. Legendary weapon, enemy critical-defense, and weapon affinity damage patches target it. |
| `g.c(int)`                            | Confirmed | Run/escape check                    | Checks encounter no-run/boss gate and computes stock escape success. Always-successful Run patch targets this helper.                                                      |
| `i`                                   | Confirmed | Field, world map, and menu runtime  | Very large class with field movement, world-map vehicle behavior, shop/menu state, map overlay, field recovery, save/load-looking routines, and many state fields.         |
| `i.L()`                               | Confirmed | Airship landing check               | While `j.a.e == 3`, action key checks current world-map terrain. Stock landing accepts terrain `0` and `10..14`; optional patch expands safe land to `10..33`.             |
| `i.V()`                               | Confirmed | Random encounter trigger            | Rolls `random(100) < aI`; `aI` rises per eligible step, resets to `-2 - random(4)` after encounters, caps at `15`, and airship movement skips encounters.                  |
| `i.l(int)`                            | Confirmed | Field recovery helper               | Inn is `0`, Sleeping Bag `1`, Tent `2`, Cottage `3`. Inn and Cottage share spell-charge recovery. Cottage revive and 15 max charge recovery patches target this method.    |
| `i` state `14 -> 15 -> 16`            | Confirmed | World-map overlay entry             | Mobile key `0` opens the full world-map overlay. Stock calls `j.e(0)` during entry, stopping active stock field/world-map BGM; optional patch nops only that stop call.    |
| `j`                                   | Partial   | Runtime tables and helpers          | Owns global runtime tables, BGM slot lists, text/render helpers, equipment helpers, and wrappers around audio selection/stop calls.                                        |
| `j.x[]`                               | Confirmed | Stock field/BGM slot list           | Hardcoded list `32768..32789`, mapping to resources `a0..a21` through `trackId & 0x1ff`.                                                                                   |
| `j.b(int,int)`                        | Confirmed | Play stock BGM slot                 | Looks up a track id through `j.a(type,index)` and delegates to `f.b(trackId)`.                                                                                             |
| `j.d(int,int)`                        | Confirmed | Start/change stock BGM slot         | Stops conflicting stock BGM slots, updates related map/menu state, then queues playback through `f.b(trackId, repeatCount)`.                                               |
| `j.e(int)`                            | Confirmed | Stop stock BGM group                | For `0`, scans `j.x[]` and queues a stop for any active stock `a0..a21` track. For nonzero, scans the secondary `j.y[]` slot list.                                         |
| `j.e(hero)`/`j.f(hero)`/`j.i(itemId)` | Confirmed | Equipment helpers                   | `j.e(hero)` and `j.f(hero)` compute weapon hit/attack; `j.i(itemId)` counts equipped copies by weapon/armor subtype.                                                       |
